## Shared attributes

Available on all layout, content, and geometry nodes.

| Attribute | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | The node's name in this file, for references: a prop target, a path segment, a link. Lowercase kebab-case, [a-z][a-z0-9-]*. Written only on nodes something points at; unique within its scope (RFC-0046). |
| `source-id` | `string` | The source tool's handle for this node, read against `source` on the root. Opaque, exporters only, written only for round-trip exports (RFC-0046). |
| `opacity` | `number` | Layer opacity, 0–1. Omitted when 1. |
| `blend` | `normal` `multiply` `screen` `overlay` `darken` `lighten` `color-dodge` `color-burn` `hard-light` `soft-light` `difference` `exclusion` `hue` `saturation` `color` `luminosity` `linear-burn` `linear-dodge` | Blend mode against layers below. Omitted when normal. |
| `rotation` | `number` | Rotation in degrees. Omitted when 0. |
| `constraint-h` | `left` `right` `center` `scale` `stretch` | Horizontal pin/resize behavior. Default left (omitted). |
| `constraint-v` | `center` `scale` `stretch` `top` `bottom` | Vertical pin/resize behavior. Default top (omitted). |
| `abs` | `boolean` | Absolute child inside auto-layout. Presence = true. Replaces layout-position="absolute". |
| `min-width` | `number` | Minimum width in px. Omitted when unset. |
| `max-width` | `number` | Maximum width in px. Omitted when unset. |
| `min-height` | `number` | Minimum height in px. Omitted when unset. |
| `max-height` | `number` | Maximum height in px. Omitted when unset. |
| `flip` | `h` `v` `both` | Mirror transform — 'h', 'v', or 'both'. |
| `filter` | `string` | CSS filter string, e.g. "brightness(1.2) contrast(0.9)". |
| `isolation` | `boolean` | Presence = true. New stacking context for blend modes (isolation: isolate). |
| `transform-origin` | `string` | Transform origin, e.g. "top-left", "center", "0% 0%". |
| `scale-x` | `number` | CSS scaleX, e.g. 1.5. |
| `scale-y` | `number` | CSS scaleY, e.g. 0.8. |
| `skew-x` | `number` | Horizontal skew in degrees. |
| `skew-y` | `number` | Vertical skew in degrees. |
| `aspect-ratio` | `string` | Aspect ratio, e.g. "16/9", "1/1". |
| `z-index` | `number` | Explicit CSS z-index. |
| `visible` | `boolean` | false = visibility:hidden (preserved in file, skipped in render). |

## Format

<a id="package"></a>
### .gui package <sup>concept</sup>

*file format*

A .gui file is a ZIP package. The markup, design tokens, font declarations, binary assets, and a preview thumbnail all live in one self-contained file.

Internally, the markup lives as design.guix — an implementation detail never surfaced to the outside. A program distinguishing a package from a raw markup string uses magic bytes: ZIP starts with PK, markup starts with <.

| Attribute | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `design.guix` | `entry` | The UI markup — always this name inside the package. |
| `preview.webp` | `entry` | Thumbnail for visual verification before opening. |
| `assets/` | `entry` | Embedded WebP images and SVG vectors. |

**Package structure**

```xml
checkout.gui  (ZIP)
├── design.guix
├── preview.webp
└── assets/
    ├── hero.webp
    └── icon-close.svg
```

**Is a .gui file just XML?**

No — a .gui file is a ZIP package whose markup (design.guix) is XML, alongside a preview thumbnail and an assets/ folder. A raw XML string is also valid input; tools tell them apart by magic bytes (ZIP starts with PK, markup with <).

*Related: [gui](#gui), [assets](#assets), [fonts](#fonts)*

<a id="gui"></a>
### gui <sup>tag</sup>

*document root*

The root element is a document envelope — never rendered. Direct children are metadata blocks or exactly one root layout node. Metadata always precedes the layout root.

platform and source describe the document itself and belong to it alone: in a multi-document package each document, library.guix included, carries its own. There is no <meta> block; files written before 0.3.6 that carry one keep working.

| Attribute | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `version` **(required)** | `string` | Spec version the document is written for: a chapter ("0.3") or a point in it ("0.3.4"). Consumers refuse a version newer than they read. Current: 0.3.11. |
| `name` | `string` | Screen or layer name from the source design. |
| `platform` | `string` | The platform the document is designed for. Open string; recommended: ios, android, web, desktop, tv, watch. Absent = unspecified — assume no default. Describes intent; changes nothing about how the document is drawn (RFC-0036). |
| `source` | `string` | The tool that exported the file. Open string; recommended: figma, penpot, sketch, html. Exporters only — a file written by hand or by an AI omits it (RFC-0036). |
| `source-id` | `string` | The exported frame's handle in the source tool, read against source. Exporters only, and only for an export meant to round-trip. See spec/SOURCES.md (RFC-0046). |

**Example**

```xml
<gui version="0.3" name="Checkout" platform="ios">
  <tokens>
    <color name="primary" value="#007AFF" />
  </tokens>
  <fonts>
    <font family="Inter" source="google" weights="400 700" />
  </fonts>
  <col w="390" fill="#F2F2F7" gap="16" p="24">
    <text value="Checkout"
          font-family="Inter" font-size="28"
          font-weight="700" fill="#1C1C1E" />
  </col>
</gui>
```

*Related: [package](#package), [root-canvas](#root-canvas), [tokens](#tokens)*

<a id="root-canvas"></a>
### Root Canvas <sup>concept</sup>

*canvas patterns*

The first layout tag under <gui> defines the canvas. Two patterns cover all cases.

> Default to <col> — it cannot clip content. <frame> children are absolutely positioned. <col> children flow vertically.

| Attribute | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `<col w="390">` | `pattern` | Content-driven screen, AI-authored. h absent — hugs children. |
| `<frame w="390" h="844">` | `pattern` | Fixed artboard, Figma export. h required. |

**Both patterns**

```xml
<!-- content-driven: h absent, hugs children -->
<gui version="0.2" name="Feed">
  <col w="390" fill="#fff" gap="0">
    ...
  </col>
</gui>

<!-- fixed artboard: h required, children absolute -->
<gui version="0.2" name="Splash">
  <frame w="390" h="844" fill="#000">
    <img x="0" y="0" src="assets/bg.webp" w="390" h="844" fit="cover" />
    <text x="24" y="720" value="Welcome" font-size="32"
          font-weight="700" fill="#fff" />
  </frame>
</gui>
```

*Related: [gui](#gui), [col](#col), [frame](#frame)*

## Metadata

<a id="tokens"></a>
### tokens <sup>tag</sup>

*design primitives*

Design system primitives. Referenced anywhere in the tree with $name. Figma Variables resolve to <tokens> entries. Only tokens used in the exported tree are emitted.

| Attribute | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `<color>` | `token` | A color: hex, rgba() or oklch(), e.g. #007AFF. |
| `<number>` | `token` | Numeric value, e.g. 12. |
| `<string>` | `token` | String value, e.g. Inter. |

**Example**

```xml
<tokens>
  <color name="primary"     value="#007AFF" />
  <number name="radius-card" value="12" />
  <string name="font-base"  value="Inter" />
</tokens>

<col fill="$surface" p="$space-md" gap="12">
  <rect fill="$primary" radius="$radius-card" w="fill" h="52" />
</col>
```

*Related: [styles](#styles), [fonts](#fonts), [fill-values](#fill-values)*

<a id="styles"></a>
### styles <sup>tag</sup>

*text styles*

Named text styles from the design system. Each <text-style> captures a full typography definition. Text nodes reference a style by name — individual font attrs are omitted when a style is applied.

Color and layout attrs are always inlined — they are not part of the text style definition. Only styles used in the exported tree are emitted.

| Attribute | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | Style name, e.g. Heading/H1. |
| `font-family` | `string` | Font family name. |
| `font-size` | `number` | Size in px. |
| `font-weight` | `number` | Numeric weight (100–900). |
| `line-height` | `number | string` | px or percent. |

**Example**

```xml
<styles>
  <text-style name="Heading/H1"
              font-family="Inter" font-size="32"
              font-weight="700" line-height="40" />
</styles>

<text text-style="Heading/H1" value="Welcome" fill="#1C1C1E" />
```

*Related: [text](#text), [tokens](#tokens), [fonts](#fonts)*

<a id="fonts"></a>
### fonts <sup>tag</sup>

*font declarations*

Font declarations for the renderer to load Google Fonts or fall back gracefully. Text nodes still carry their own font-family and font-weight — the fonts block makes those families resolvable.

| Attribute | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `family` | `string` | Font family name. |
| `source` | `google | system | unresolved` | Where the font is resolved from. |
| `category` | `string` | e.g. sans-serif, serif, monospace. |
| `weights` | `string` | Space-separated numeric weights, e.g. 400 600 700. |
| `styles` | `string` | normal italic. |

**Example**

```xml
<fonts>
  <font family="Inter" source="google"
        category="sans-serif"
        weights="400 500 600 700" styles="normal italic" />
</fonts>
```

*Related: [text](#text), [styles](#styles), [tokens](#tokens)*

<a id="assets"></a>
### Assets <sup>concept</sup>

*images & vectors*

Images and vector artwork are embedded in assets/ and referenced inline via src — no declaration block, no $id indirection.

All raster images are converted to WebP at 0.85 quality by the Figma plugin. External URLs are a fallback only. If a URL reference fails to load, the renderer shows an asset not loaded error state — no silent failure.

| Attribute | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `assets/img.webp` | `pattern` | Embedded raster (default for all exports). |
| `assets/icon.svg` | `pattern` | Embedded vector artwork. |
| `https://…` | `pattern` | External URL — fallback only. |

**Example**

```xml
<img src="assets/hero.webp" w="390" h="240" fit="cover" />
<img src="assets/icon-close.svg" w="24" h="24" />
<img src="https://example.com/photo.jpg" w="390" h="240" fit="cover" />
```

*Related: [img](#img), [package](#package), [gui](#gui)*

<a id="components"></a>
### components <sup>tag</sup>

*component system*

A <components> block above the layout root holds every component definition. An <instance> places one by id and passes prop values as flat attributes.

<component id> defines one reusable component: an optional <props> block, then one layout body. <component-set id> groups <variant id> members; an instance references a variant by its own id.

A component may declare slots — layout containers carrying slot="name" — that an instance fills with content (RFC-0044).

In a multi-document package, components declared in library.guix are shared with every document (RFC-0042).

**Component + instance**

```xml
<components>
  <component name="Card/Product" id="comp-card">
    <props>
      <prop name="title" type="string" target="title" />
      <prop name="accent" type="color" target="badge" />
    </props>
    <col w="320" radius="12" fill="#fff" p="16" gap="8">
      <text id="title" value="Product Name" font-size="16" font-weight="600" />
      <rect id="badge" w="24" h="4" fill="#0A84FF" />
      <col slot="details" gap="4" />
    </col>
  </component>
</components>

<instance component="comp-card" title="Nike Air Max 90" accent="#FF3B30" />
```

*Related: [prop](#prop), [instance](#instance), [slot](#slot)*

<a id="prop"></a>
### prop <sup>tag</sup>

*typed component prop*

A <prop> inside a component's <props> block declares one value an instance may pass. Prop types are data types — string, boolean, number, color, image, component, style — and bind names which attribute of the target changes.

number and style always need bind, because each could mean several attributes. A list in target applies one value to several layers at once.

A path reaches a node inside a nested instance, so a component can expose it as an ordinary prop: every segment but the last names an <instance> by id, and the next segment is read in that instance's component body.

| Attribute | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` **(required)** | `string` | The attribute an instance passes the value as. |
| `type` **(required)** | `string | boolean | number | color | image | component | style` | A data type (RFC-0034). |
| `target` | `string` | Layer id(s) the value applies to, space-separated. Each is an id in the body, or a path through instances in it — tab-1/label sets label inside the instance tab-1 (RFC-0046). Optional for a string prop whose name is the id of exactly one <text> in the body. |
| `bind` | `string` | The attribute overridden on the target. Required for number and style. Defaults: string → value, boolean → visible, color → fill (or border-color; stroke is its old name), image → src, component → component. |

**Typed props**

```xml
<props>
  <prop name="label"       type="string"  target="label" />
  <prop name="disabled"    type="boolean" target="button" />
  <prop name="bg"          type="color"   target="surface" />
  <prop name="radius"      type="number"  target="surface" bind="radius" />
  <prop name="label-style" type="style"   target="label"   bind="text-style" />
  <prop name="accent"      type="color"   target="icon label indicator" />
</props>
```

*Related: [components](#components), [instance](#instance)*

## Layout

<a id="frame"></a>
### frame <sup>tag</sup>

*fixed container*

Fixed container. Children are absolutely positioned with x and y attributes. Maps to a Figma frame without auto-layout.

w and h are required. clip (boolean presence) clips content to bounds.

**Maps to Figma:** Frame (auto-layout off)

| Attribute | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` |  |
| `detached-from` | `string` | The component this container was detached from: a component or variant id declared in the document or its library. Exporters only; changes nothing on screen (RFC-0035). |
| `x` | `number` |  |
| `y` | `number` |  |
| `w` **(required)** | `number | 'fill'` | Required on frame |
| `h` **(required)** | `number | 'fill'` | Required on frame |
| `fill` | `fill` |  |
| `fill-style` | `string` |  |
| `effect-style` | `string` |  |
| `radius` | `number | string` |  |
| `corner-smoothing` | `number` |  |
| `border` | `string` |  |
| `border-color` | `color | token` |  |
| `border-width` | `number` |  |
| `border-style` | `solid` `dashed` `dotted` |  |
| `border-align` | `center` `inside` `outside` |  |
| `shadow` | `string` |  |
| `clip` | `boolean` |  |
| `clip-path` | `string` | A shape to clip to: inset(), circle(), ellipse() or polygon(); % of the node's box (RFC-0028). |
| `overflow-x` | `hidden` `visible` `scroll` `auto` |  |
| `overflow-y` | `hidden` `visible` `scroll` `auto` |  |
| `border-image` | `string` |  |
| `outline` | `string` |  |
| `outline-offset` | `number` |  |
| `slot` | `string` | Declares this container a slot, by name. Not on a component's root; not inside another slot. |
| `slot-accept` | `string` | Space-separated component or component-set ids. Present = the slot takes only instances of these, flat. |
| `slot-min` | `number` | Advisory minimum item count. A quality finding, never an error. |
| `slot-max` | `number` | Advisory maximum item count. A quality finding, never an error. |
| `mask-src` | `asset` | The mask: an SVG or raster asset. |
| `mask-x` | `number` | Where the mask sits, relative to the container. Default 0. |
| `mask-y` | `number` |  |
| `mask-width` | `number` | The mask's size. Default: the container's size. |
| `mask-height` | `number` |  |
| `mask-mode` | `alpha` `luminance` | alpha (the asset's opacity, default) or luminance (its brightness). |
| `mask-invert` | `boolean` | Presence = true. Cut the mask's shape out instead of keeping it. |

Also accepts all [shared attributes](#shared-attributes).

**Example**

```xml
<frame w="390" h="844" fill="#FFFFFF" clip>
  <img x="0" y="0" src="assets/bg.webp" w="390" h="240" fit="cover" />
  <text x="24" y="260" value="Good morning"
        font-size="28" font-weight="700" fill="#1C1C1E" />
</frame>
```

**What's the difference between frame and col?**

A frame positions its children absolutely with x/y and maps to a Figma frame with auto-layout off; a col flows its children vertically with auto-layout. Use frame for fixed artboards, col for content-driven screens.

*Related: [col](#col), [group](#group), [rect](#rect)*

<a id="stack"></a>
### stack <sup>tag</sup>

*auto-layout*

<row> is horizontal, <col> is vertical. <stack> requires an explicit direction. Children are flow-positioned.

w / h absent = hug content; "fill" = fill parent; number = fixed px. p accepts CSS shorthand (1–4 values). gap="auto" distributes space evenly.

**Maps to Figma:** Frame (auto-layout on)

| Attribute | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` |  |
| `detached-from` | `string` | The component this container was detached from: a component or variant id declared in the document or its library. Exporters only; changes nothing on screen (RFC-0035). |

| `x` | `number` |  |
| `y` | `number` |  |
| `w` | `number | 'fill'` | Absent = hug children |
| `h` | `number | 'fill'` | Absent = hug children |
| `gap` | `gap` | Gap between items and (when wrapping) between rows. "16"      fixed 16px "auto"    space-between (bare attribute = auto) "16 10"   16px items, 10px rows "16 auto" 16px items, rows distributed |

| `wrap` | `boolean` | Enable wrapping. Presence = true. |

Also accepts all [shared attributes](#shared-attributes).

**Example**

```xml
<col w="fill" gap="12" p="16" fill="#fff" radius="12">
  <text value="Settings" font-size="17" font-weight="600" fill="#1C1C1E" />

</col>
```

| `mask-x` | `number` | Where the mask sits, relative to the container. Default 0. |
| `mask-y` | `number` |  |
| `mask-width` | `number` | The mask's size. Default: the container's size. |
| `mask-height` | `number` |  |

```xml
  <img src="assets/avatar.webp" w="32" h="32" radius="16" fit="cover" />
</row>
```

<a id="col"></a>
### col <sup>tag</sup>

*vertical auto-layout*

<col> is a vertical auto-layout container — children flow top to bottom. It is shorthand for <stack direction="vertical"> and the recommended default screen root.

w / h absent = hug content; "fill" = fill parent; number = fixed px. gap="auto" distributes space evenly.

<a id="group"></a>
### group <sup>tag</sup>

*logical grouping*

No layout behavior. Children are absolutely positioned relative to the group origin. Maps to a Figma group node.

A mask is mask-src on the container — any layout container, not only a group — and masks everything it draws. An exporter turns a design tool's mask layer into an SVG or raster asset and writes it there (RFC-0028).

| `x` | `number` |  |
| `y` | `number` |  |
| `w` **(required)** | `number` | Required on group — no content to derive size from |
| `h` **(required)** | `number` | Required on group — no content to derive size from |
| `mask-src` | `asset` | The mask: an SVG or raster asset. |

| `mask-height` | `number` |  |

## Content

<a id="instance"></a>
### instance <sup>tag</sup>

*component placement*

Places a component by id. Prop values and overrides are flat attributes, whatever their type; tokens and assets use the usual $name form.

Its only children are <slot> fills. Setting w or h scales the component body to fit.

**Maps to Figma:** Instance

| Attribute | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `component` **(required)** | `string` | Component or variant id. |
| `id` | `string` | Names the instance so a path can pass through it: `tab-1/label` (RFC-0046). |
| `source-id` | `string` | The source tool's handle for this instance (RFC-0046). |
| `x` | `number` |  |
| `y` | `number` |  |
| `w` | `number | 'fill'` | Absent = the component's own width; scales the body when set. |
| `h` | `number | 'fill'` | Absent = the component's own height; scales the body when set. |

Also accepts all [shared attributes](#shared-attributes).

**Instance with props and a slot**

```xml
<instance component="comp-screen" title="Audio Settings">
  <slot name="body">
    <instance component="comp-toggle" label="Lossless" />
    <instance component="comp-toggle" label="Spatial" />
  </slot>
</instance>
```

*Related: [components](#components), [prop](#prop), [slot](#slot)*

<a id="slot"></a>
### slot <sup>tag</sup>

*content for a component slot*

A component declares a slot by putting slot="name" on one of its layout containers; that container's layout applies to whatever is inserted, and its own children are the fallback. slot-accept limits it to instances of listed components or component sets; slot-min and slot-max advise a count.

An instance fills a slot with a <slot name> child. <slot> is valid only directly inside an <instance>, and its content cannot read the component's props. An unfilled slot keeps its fallback; one left empty renders nothing — no box, padding, or gap.

| Attribute | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` **(required)** | `string` | The slot this fills. The component must declare it; each slot is filled once. |

**Declare and fill**

```xml
<!-- in the component -->
<row slot="tabs" slot-accept="compset-tab-item" slot-max="5" w="fill" gap="8" />

<!-- in the instance -->
<slot name="tabs">
  <instance component="tab-library" />
  <instance component="tab-settings" />
</slot>
```

*Related: [components](#components), [instance](#instance)*

<a id="text"></a>
### text <sup>tag</sup>

*text node*

Single-style text is self-closing with a value attribute. Mixed-style text has <segment> children — each segment overrides font attrs for its run.

text-style references a named style; individual font attrs are omitted when a style is referenced. Variable fonts use font-variation; OpenType features use font-feature.

fill colors the glyphs, on <text> and on each <segment> — the same attribute that colors a frame. There is no color attribute on text (RFC-0022).

<a id="rect"></a>
### rect <sup>tag</sup>

*rectangle*

Sugar for a childless <frame>. Signals decorative intent — no layout children. w and h are required.

Supports all visual attributes: fill, border, radius, opacity, blend, rotation, appearance. Does not accept layout attributes.

Border shorthand: "[width] [color] [style] [align]". Defaults: 1px solid center.

| `h` **(required)** | `number | 'fill'` | Unified height. Replaces height + sizing-v. Absent = hug (valid on row/col/stack/text/instance only). "fill" = grow to fill parent. number = fixed px. Or a share of the parent: '50%'. Not valid on frame/img/svg — those require explicit values. |
| `fill` | `fill` |  |
| `fill-style` | `string` |  |
| `effect-style` | `string` |  |
| `radius` | `number | string` |  |
| `corner-smoothing` | `number` |  |
| `border` | `string` |  |

| `border-width` | `number` |  |

| `border-align` | `center` `inside` `outside` |  |
| `shadow` | `string` |  |
| `fill-rule` | `nonzero` `evenodd` |  |

Also accepts all [shared attributes](#shared-attributes).

**Example**

```xml
<rect fill="$primary" w="342" h="52" radius="12" />
<rect fill="$surface" w="320" h="80" radius="12" border="1 #E5E5EA" />

```

## Appearance

<a id="appearance"></a>
### appearance <sup>tag</sup>

*paint & effects stack*

A non-layout child that describes the parent's complete paint and effect stack. Used when a node has multiple fills, complex borders, or multiple effects.

All three stacks — fills, borders, effects — are ordered in document order. When <appearance> contains at least one <border>, the border shorthand on the parent is ignored.

Outlines are border — the shorthand, its longhands, or <border> entries here. <border> belongs inside <appearance>, never directly in a node, and there is no stroke attribute or <stroke> entry (RFC-0022).

| Attribute | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `<fill>` | `child` | color, linear-gradient, radial-gradient, angular-gradient, image. |
| `<border>` | `child` | color, w, align (inside/center/outside), style, dash, cap, join. |
| `<effect>` | `child` | drop-shadow, inner-shadow, layer-blur, background-blur, glass. |

**Multi-fill + shadow**

```xml
<frame w="320" h="180" radius="16">
  <appearance>
    <fill type="image" src="assets/hero.webp" fit="cover" />
    <fill type="linear-gradient" value="linear-gradient(180deg, #00000000 0%, #000000CC 100%)" />
    <effect type="drop-shadow" x="0" y="8" radius="24" color="#00000033" />
  </appearance>
</frame>
```

*Related: [fill-values](#fill-values), [shared-attrs](#shared-attrs), [frame](#frame)*

<a id="fill-values"></a>
### Fill Values <sup>property</sup>

*fill attribute formats*

The fill attribute accepts a color — hex, rgba() or oklch() — a gradient function, or a token reference. The same three color notations work everywhere a color goes: strokes, borders, shadows, gradient stops, tokens and fill styles. rgb() is tolerated for existing exports but is not part of the format; write hex.

Dimensions are bare numbers in pixels. Sizes (w, h, min-width, max-width, min-height, max-height) may also be a share of the parent: w="50%". There is no px suffix, rem, vw/vh or calc() (RFC-0033).

Gradient syntax mirrors CSS — linear-gradient(), radial-gradient(), conic-gradient(). Token references use $name syntax.

| Attribute | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `Hex opaque` | `format` | #1C1C1E. |
| `Hex + alpha` | `format` | #1C1C1ECC (last byte = alpha). |
| `rgba` | `format` | rgba(28, 28, 30, 0.8) — integers 0–255, alpha 0–1. The readable form for any color with opacity (RFC-0033). |
| `oklch` | `format` | oklch(0.627 0.258 29.23) or oklch(0.6 0.2 250 / 0.5) — wide-gamut, stored as written (RFC-0033). |
| `Linear gradient` | `format` | linear-gradient(135deg, #FF6B6B 0%, #4ECDC4 100%). |
| `Radial gradient` | `format` | radial-gradient(circle at 50% 30%, #FFFFFF 0%, #000000 100%). |
| `Angular gradient` | `format` | conic-gradient(from 0deg at 50% 50%, #FF0000 0deg, #0000FF 360deg). |
| `Token` | `format` | $primary. |

**Fill values in use**

```xml
<rect fill="#1C1C1ECC" w="100" h="100" />
<rect fill="linear-gradient(135deg, #FF6B6B 0%, #4ECDC4 100%)" w="fill" h="160" />
<rect fill="$primary" w="fill" h="52" radius="12" />
```

*Related: [tokens](#tokens), [appearance](#appearance), [rect](#rect)*

<a id="shared-attrs"></a>
### Shared Attrs <sup>property</sup>

*all nodes*

Visual attributes available on all layout, content, and geometry nodes.

id names a node so something can point at it: a prop target, a path segment through an instance (target="tab-1/label"). Lowercase kebab-case, written only where something points, unique within its scope — the screen tree of a document, or one component or variant body. A reference that does not resolve is an error (RFC-0046).

source-id is the source tool's own handle for a node, read against source on the <gui> root. It is optional, written by exporters only when the user asks for an export that can go back, and opaque: the format never parses it. A document with any source-id must declare source. What each tool writes is in spec/SOURCES.md (RFC-0046).

detached-from names the component a layout container was detached from, when an exporter could not keep a heavily-overridden instance as an <instance>. It holds a component or variant id declared in the document or its library, and must resolve; it changes nothing on screen. Only <instance> carries component (RFC-0035).

Boolean presence convention: bare attributes without a value are treated as true. <frame clip> = <frame clip="true">. Applies to: clip, mask-invert, wrap, abs, truncate, reverse-z.

Clipping and masks (RFC-0028): clip clips children to the box and its radius; clip-path clips to a shape — inset(), circle(), ellipse() or polygon(), with % of the node's box; mask-src masks everything a container draws through an SVG or raster asset, placed by mask-x, mask-y, mask-width and mask-height, read by mask-mode (alpha or luminance), and cut out instead with mask-invert. The mask attributes mean nothing without mask-src. There is no mask flag on a child and no mask-composite.

| Attribute | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | The node's name in this file, for references: a prop target, a path segment, a link. Lowercase kebab-case, [a-z][a-z0-9-]*. Written only on nodes something points at; unique within its scope (RFC-0046). |
| `source-id` | `string` | The source tool's handle for this node, read against `source` on the root. Opaque, exporters only, written only for round-trip exports (RFC-0046). |
| `opacity` | `number` | Layer opacity, 0–1. Omitted when 1. |
| `blend` | `normal` `multiply` `screen` `overlay` `darken` `lighten` `color-dodge` `color-burn` `hard-light` `soft-light` `difference` `exclusion` `hue` `saturation` `color` `luminosity` `linear-burn` `linear-dodge` | Blend mode against layers below. Omitted when normal. |
| `rotation` | `number` | Rotation in degrees. Omitted when 0. |
| `constraint-h` | `left` `right` `center` `scale` `stretch` | Horizontal pin/resize behavior. Default left (omitted). |
| `constraint-v` | `center` `scale` `stretch` `top` `bottom` | Vertical pin/resize behavior. Default top (omitted). |
| `abs` | `boolean` | Absolute child inside auto-layout. Presence = true. Replaces layout-position="absolute". |
| `min-width` | `number` | Minimum width in px. Omitted when unset. |
| `max-width` | `number` | Maximum width in px. Omitted when unset. |
| `min-height` | `number` | Minimum height in px. Omitted when unset. |
| `max-height` | `number` | Maximum height in px. Omitted when unset. |
| `flip` | `h` `v` `both` | Mirror transform — 'h', 'v', or 'both'. |
| `filter` | `string` | CSS filter string, e.g. "brightness(1.2) contrast(0.9)". |
| `isolation` | `boolean` | Presence = true. New stacking context for blend modes (isolation: isolate). |
| `transform-origin` | `string` | Transform origin, e.g. "top-left", "center", "0% 0%". |
| `scale-x` | `number` | CSS scaleX, e.g. 1.5. |
| `scale-y` | `number` | CSS scaleY, e.g. 0.8. |
| `skew-x` | `number` | Horizontal skew in degrees. |
| `skew-y` | `number` | Vertical skew in degrees. |
| `aspect-ratio` | `string` | Aspect ratio, e.g. "16/9", "1/1". |
| `z-index` | `number` | Explicit CSS z-index. |
| `visible` | `boolean` | false = visibility:hidden (preserved in file, skipped in render). |

**Shared attrs in use**

```xml
<img src="assets/overlay.webp" w="390" h="240" opacity="0.6" blend="multiply" />
<rect fill="#FF3B30" w="40" h="40" radius="4" rotation="45" />
<rect fill="$primary" w="fill" h="52" constraint-v="bottom" />
```

*Related: [appearance](#appearance), [fill-values](#fill-values), [frame](#frame)*
